expectations.text: Starts at 110 and deducts per unimplemented practice using the DoD Assessment Methodology weights (5, 3, or 1 points)
expectations.evidence: You start from a maximum possible score of 110 and subtract points for each requirement that is NOT fully implemented... 1-point... 3-point... 5-point requirements

expectations.text: States the score range: +110 down to -203
expectations.evidence: Only says 'Scores can theoretically go negative'; never states the actual range floor of −203

expectations.evidence: You'll also need a System Security Plan (SSP)... Your score, along with the date... gets entered into SPRS, tied to your assessment methodology (Basic self-assessment, Medium, or High)

expectations.text: Notes specific weighting rules: MFA (3.5.3) and FIPS-validated encryption (3.13.11) carry special treatment (5/3-point nuances), or accurately describes the 1/3/5 weighting logic with examples
